question: Daksh travels 774 km at 86 km/hr, the next 567 km at 63 km/hr and the next 135 km at 27 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to two decimal places) for the whole journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = 774 + 567 + 135 = 1476 km

Total Time = (774 ÷ 86) + (567 ÷ 63) + (135 ÷ 27) = 9 + 9 + 5 = 23 hours

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 1476 ÷ 23 ≈ 64.1739 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 64.17 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance 1 (D₁) = 774 km, Speed 1 (S₁) = 86 km/hr

Distance 2 (D₂) = 567 km, Speed 2 (S₂) = 63 km/hr

Distance 3 (D₃) = 135 km, Speed 3 (S₃) = 27 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time
